J2.evidence: The verse قسموا البلاد فما بها لمقيلهم * تضغيث مفتصل يباع فصيله is obscure/likely corrupt (تضغيث, مفتصل). TR gives a confident word-by-word rendering ('kaylûle yerlerinde, yavrusu satılan sütten kesilmiş devenin karışık otu bile yoktur') with no note that it is tentative, while EN leaves it unglossed with a translator's note. Whether the TR meaning is right cannot be established from the text; needs scholarly judgement (or a Mütercim notu marking it tentative). Rest of TR (فيقتل note, جاءانا/جاءنا readings, المشرقين, الزهدمان, البصرتان, الموصلان) is faithful.
